question: The orbit of a geostationary satellite is circular. The time period of the satellite depends on

options.text: height of the satellite from the surface of Earth

solution:
$$T = 2\pi\sqrt{\frac{r^3}{GM}}, \qquad r = R + h$$

$T$ depends on the mass of the Earth, on the radius of the orbit, and so on the height above the surface. (It does not depend on the mass of the satellite.)
